text:
Below are seven sketches for the sequence-mixing part (four leaps, two ports, one tune), after the required seed pass.

PASS 1 (scratch):
1. A query may not attend to its own key (plant self-incompatibility forces outcrossing).
2. A key's attractiveness falls with how much attention earlier queries already took from it (ecological depletion, congestion pricing).
3. The slow rotary bands count learned content events instead of tokens (phase-locked loop, event-driven sampling).
4. Keys keep a per-token magnitude after QK-norm, a learned "second signal" (T-cell costimulation, anergy).
5. Values are rotated too and the head output un-rotated, so retrieved content carries relative distance (VO-RoPE).
6. Content and position get separate softmaxes mixed as a convex combination instead of one summed logit (mixture, not product of experts).
7. One rotary key is computed once and reused by all 12 layers (cross-layer positional address).
8. The rotary query is a learned per-head constant, making the positional logit a pure learned distance prior.
9. Keys are centred against their own causal prefix mean so only novelty is matchable (negative selection of "self").
10. Heads are pushed to occupy disjoint key sets by a repulsion between their attention rows (niche partitioning).
11. The SDPA temperature follows a training-time schedule, hot early, cold late (simulated annealing).
12. Rotary phases get random per-sequence jitter during training only (dithering).
Kept 1, 2, 3, 4 (the quota asks for four leaps): they are farthest from the brief's known and open items, which cover temperature (11), learned frequencies, output gates, sinks and windows.

IDEA: QK-norm over the rotary channels too
MECHANISM: q_norm and k_norm cover only the 64 content dims, so the 32 rotary dims enter the 1/sqrt(96) softmax unnormalized: at init their logit std is about 0.09 against 0.82 for content (a 10x gap), and later they are unbounded, so the 22.7 max logits can be carried by the position term. Add an RMSNorm with its own gain on the per-head rotary query and on the shared rotary key, so position and content compete at a controlled scale from step 0, which DeepSeek-V4 does by norming whole query heads.
PREDICTION: previous-token and induction heads form earlier, so the loss at step 100 is lower by about 0.03 to 0.05; final loss lower by 0.01 to 0.02; parameters +64 per layer; step time unchanged.
TEST: 45 matched steps against baseline, logging the std of the rotary-only and content-only logit contributions at steps 0 and 45; if the curve is not below baseline by step 45, drop it.
SOURCE: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.19348v1
TARGET: max attention logit, down
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: port

IDEA: Rotary projection init scale
MECHANISM: The rotary projection and the rotary slice of wq start at std 0.02 like every other matrix, but their logits are a dot product of two tiny unnormalized vectors, so Muon's fixed-magnitude updates need many steps before position matters at all. Multiplying the init of these two weight slices by 3 brings the positional logit std at init to about 0.8, level with content, without adding any module.
PREDICTION: loss at steps 45 to 200 lower by 0.02 to 0.04; final gain small, 0.003 to 0.01; no parameter or time cost.
TEST: 45 matched steps at multipliers 2, 3 and 4 against baseline; falsified if none beats baseline at step 45 by at least 0.01.
SOURCE: own
TARGET: validation loss only
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: tune

IDEA: Chunked-context warmup inside Attention.forward
MECHANISM: Early in training the useful keys are mostly local, and a 1024-wide softmax dilutes the gradient over hundreds of irrelevant keys; modded-nanogpt ramps its attention window from 128 up to the full length for this reason. Here the same effect is obtained with no mask and no kernel change: during the first 40 percent of forward calls (counted inside Attention in train mode from the config's step total) the (B,H,T,D) tensors are reshaped to (4B,H,256,D), then (2B,H,512,D), then full, all with is_causal flash attention; eval mode is always full.
PREDICTION: step time down 3 to 6 percent during the chunked phase; loss at step 300 lower by about 0.03; final loss lower by 0.005 to 0.01 if late positions recover in the full-context phase; no parameter change.
TEST: 45 matched steps at chunk 4 should already sit below baseline (easy win early); the real check is the self-reported loss on the last 256 positions of each window after a full run, which must not exceed baseline.
SOURCE: https://github.com/KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt
TARGET: validation loss only, with loss at late positions as the guard
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: port

IDEA: Self-incompatibility: no self-key in the deep layers
MECHANISM: Shared structure: in self-incompatible plants a pollen grain (query) whose allele matches the stigma (key) of the same flower is rejected, forcing exchange between individuals; here query i and key i are both linear images of the same x_i, and with QK-norm q_i·k_i is the cheapest high logit, so deep heads collapse to near-one-hot self-attention (entropy 0.67), which is a per-token linear map already provided by the residual stream. Instantiation: in the last 6 layers, queries 1..T−1 attend to keys and values 0..T−2 with is_causal, so query i sees only 0..i−1, query 0 outputs zero; no mask tensor, flash kept. Where it breaks: the plant gains genetic diversity, while here the self slot also serves as the no-op sink, so mass may migrate to token 0.
PREDICTION: deep-layer entropy rises above 1.0; first-token mass rises from 0.6 percent to a few percent; loss lower by 0.005 to 0.015 if the freed heads retrieve context; parameters and step time unchanged.
TEST: 45 matched steps with deep-layer entropy and first-token mass logged.
SOURCE: own
TARGET: attention entropy in deep layers, up
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: leap
BREAKS: a query's own key is a valid attention target.
KEEPS: causal softmax, RoPE, QK-norm, scale, layer count, residual mixing.
P_SUCCESS: 0.15
KILL: loss at 45 steps above baseline by more than 0.03, or first-token mass above 10 percent at step 45.

IDEA: Causal key depletion (overgrazing)
MECHANISM: Shared structure: in a consumer-resource system consumers arriving in order deplete a shared resource, so a patch grazed by many earlier consumers yields less to later ones; here queries are consumers arriving in position order, keys are patches, and P[i,j] is consumption. Instantiation, in the last 2 layers only: S = q·k/sqrt(96), P0 = causal softmax(S), D = exclusive cumsum of P0 over queries, S' = S − λ_h·log1p(D), output = softmax(S')·v, with λ_h per head initialised at 0 so training starts exactly at baseline. Where it breaks: ecological resources regenerate and depletion is physical, while here λ is learned and nothing stops it staying at 0, and the attention matrices must be materialised, which costs memory.
PREDICTION: peak VRAM rises by roughly 0.1 to 0.3 GB under activation checkpointing of those two attention cores; step time up 10 to 25 percent; deep-layer entropy up; loss lower by 0.005 to 0.015.
TEST: first a 3-step smoke for peak VRAM and step time (must stay under 5.6 GB and 9.5 s), then 45 matched steps.
SOURCE: own
TARGET: attention entropy in deep layers, up
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: leap
BREAKS: a key's attractiveness is independent of how much attention earlier queries already took from it.
KEEPS: softmax over keys, causal mask, QK-norm, RoPE, all other 10 layers unchanged.
P_SUCCESS: 0.10
KILL: VRAM over 5.6 GB at the 3-step check, or loss at 45 steps above baseline by more than 0.02.

IDEA: Event-time clock for the slow rotary band
MECHANISM: Shared structure: a phase-locked loop or event-driven sampler derives its clock from the signal, counting events rather than wall-time ticks; here RoPE phase is inv_freq·t with t the token index, and with theta 10000 the seven slowest of the 16 rotary frequencies have wavelengths of 1.1k to 35k tokens, so within a 1024 context they rotate less than one cycle and are a near-constant band the model pays 14 channels for with almost no positional resolution. Instantiation: keep the nine fast frequencies on token time; for the seven slow ones replace t by p_j = cumsum of g_j' for j' ≤ j, with g = sigmoid(w·x + b), one scalar per layer per token, b set so g ≈ 1 at init (exactly baseline), so the slow band counts learned events such as sentence or clause boundaries; cos/sin become (B,T,7) tensors and the relative-position identity still holds because q and k use the same p. Where it breaks: a PLL locks to a periodic reference and has a fixed loop gain, while here the gate is unconstrained and could saturate to a constant, reverting the band to its current near-DC state.
PREDICTION: loss at late positions and on recall tokens down; step time up about 1 percent; parameters +385 per layer.
TEST: 45 matched steps, then inspect the gate: if its per-token std is below 0.02 at step 45 the mechanism is dead; falsified if the loss is not below baseline by step 45.
SOURCE: own, building on CoPE https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.18719
TARGET: loss at late positions, down
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: leap
BREAKS: rotary phase is a function of the token index alone.
KEEPS: fixed theta, 32 shared rotary dims, the nine fast frequencies unchanged, decoupled channels, QK-norm.
P_SUCCESS: 0.12
KILL: loss at 45 steps above baseline by more than 0.02.

IDEA: Costimulation gate: per-token key magnitude after QK-norm
MECHANISM: Shared structure: a T cell activates only when antigen affinity is above a threshold and a second costimulatory signal is present, so low-affinity or signal-less encounters are ignored; here QK-RMSNorm forces every key to the same norm, so a function word's key competes with a content word's at equal strength and informativeness has to be encoded in direction, which costs capacity. Instantiation: k ← k_norm(k) · 2·sigmoid(a_h·latent + b_h) with a_h a 128→1 map per head on the compressed latent and b_h set so the gate is 1 at init; this is a key-side, token-dependent magnitude bounded in (0,2), not a temperature, since queries and the scale are untouched. Where it breaks: immune thresholds are all-or-none and tied to a real danger signal, while this gate is soft and nothing in the loss forces it to mean informativeness; Qwen's gating study also found key gating weaker than output gating.
PREDICTION: recall-token and rare-token loss down; parameters +4.6k per layer; step time up about 1 percent.
TEST: 45 matched steps; the gate's per-token std at step 45 must exceed 0.05 or the mechanism is inert; falsified if the loss is not below baseline by step 45.
SOURCE: own
TARGET: recall-token loss, down
SCOPE: validation loss at 1024
KIND: leap
BREAKS: all keys have the same norm after QK-norm.
KEEPS: RMSNorm on q and k, fixed scale, RoPE, causal softmax, values unchanged.
P_SUCCESS: 0.12
KILL: loss at 45 steps above baseline by more than 0.02, or gate std below 0.02 at step 45.

The cheapest first checks are the rotary-norm port and the init-scale tune, since both need one short matched run and no new memory. The depletion leap needs a VRAM check before anything else.
